about.en: LLYon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Eli Lilly and Company, issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by LLY shares and is a total-return tracker: it gives the economic exposure of holding LLY with dividends reinvested, so one token does not necessarily equal one share. It is deployed on Ethereum (0xf192957AE52dB3eb088654403CC2eDeD014ae556), BNB Chain and Solana.
